name: security-checks
title: 보안 검사 — 비밀값·의존성·SAST
use: Security scanners plus a threat-model AI review on a target repo; runs monthly alongside deps-audit.
rules: The target repo path is given in the request text. Do not edit, commit, checkout or install anything in the target repo; do not install tools; never run the target repo's code. The runner writes only ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/<key>/<HEAD>/checks-security.json (same store key as arch-map) and one Markdown report arch/<key>/security-report-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.md per run (newest 10 kept). The threat-model review stage writes only through scripts/arch_checks.py --log-review / --mark, into ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/<key>/security-log.jsonl. A missing threat model is not a failure: one line pointing to templates/oss-scanner/. Metadata only: never copy tool messages, secret values, matched text or source lines into a report or the log.

stages.title: 보안 검사
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_checks.py --repo <repo> --category security` once from this repository (it detects the scanners, runs each with a timeout and writes checks-security.json). Online lookups (npm audit, osv-scanner, semgrep registry packs) run by default after a reachability probe; offline they are reported skipped. Add `--offline` only when the request asks for no network. Add `--images` only when the request asks to include images. Report its printed line only. Do not rerun with other options, do not run any tool yourself, do not fix findings.

stages.title: 위협 모델 리뷰
stages.task: Orchestrator: session has a security-review subagent for THIS repo? Bash `[pl-agent:security-checks/위협 모델 리뷰=<agent>]`, then use it. Read `<repo>/.oss-scanner/threat_model.md` or `<repo>/threat_model.md`. Neither: print exactly `no threat model — copy <sidereus>/templates/oss-scanner/ to <repo>/.oss-scanner/` (<sidereus> = this repo), then a default lens: authz bypass (IDOR, no checks), injection (SQL incl. MyBatis `${}`, command, path), secrets/config, SSRF, unsafe deserialize/files, business-state skips. A = `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_checks.py --repo <repo>`: (1) `A --log-show` = open findings; each fixed at HEAD: `A --mark <slug>@<file> resolved`; NEVER mark false-positive, propose it. (2) Rate in-scope parts by its severity rubric; new findings to `A --log-review` as TSV `sev<TAB>file:line<TAB>slug<TAB>description` (sev critical..low; stable kebab slug). Never quote source or secrets; no edits, runs, no installs. Report per-severity counts (unverified), resolved, FP proposals.
